dct_description_sm: Abstract: This map data layer represents the footprints of all buildings, larger than 100 square feet, for the City of Cambridge, Massachusetts. Coverage includes Institutional (public buildings, including schools, libraries, churches, government centers, hospitals, major government institutions); Municipal (City owned buildings); Subway headhouses (outline of subway headhouse). Detached garages are included, but other minor structures such as sheds are not. No structure smaller than 10'x10' is represented.

Purpose: These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mappng purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. More advanced user applications may focus on urban and regional planning, and associated themes such as economic and demographic analysis as well as disaster and emergency planning (generally building footprints layers are useful in identifying building structures and to facilitate applications that search by street name and address).
